FX result follows net FX exposure and exchange-rate movement; no bilateral household payer is required.
CER/CVS aggregates heterogeneous indexed assets and liabilities.
2018 and Q4-2023 credit-loss charges are negative contributions.
For an identified household credit contract, interest is a direct household→bank gross-revenue flow.
Aggregate abnormal interest/CER/service components are not sector-split.
